subject: DI04005011

body.en:
Definitions

Pulp is a fibrous material in which plant fibres are liberated sufficiently for sheet formation.Paper is a coherent sheet/network formed mainly by depositing aqueous fibre stock,dewatering and drying;bonding develops largely between fibres as water is removed.

Classification of pulping methods

Mechanical pulping separates fibres largely by mechanical energy:high yield butmore retained lignin and lower long-term brightness/strength in many grades.Chemical pulping dissolves much lignin:soda,sulfite and sulfate(Kraft) processes.Semichemical processes combine partial chemical treatment with mechanical separation.Recycled-fibre pulping repulps used paper and may require screening/cleaning/deinking.Method selection balances yield,strength,brightness,cost and chemical/energy recovery.

Paper properties and uses

Basis weight,moisture,formation,tensile/tear/burst strength,smoothness,opacity,porosity and absorbency influence selection.Writing/printing,packaging,tissue and technical grades use different fibre/filler/sizing systems.Not every pulp is bleached or every paper coated.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યાઓ

Sheet formation માટે યોગ્ય રીતે liberated plant fibresનું material એટલે pulp. Aqueous fibre stock deposit,dewater/dry કરીને બનેલું coherent fibre network/sheet એટલે paper;water દૂર થતાં fibres વચ્ચે bonding વિકસે છે.

Pulping Methodsનું વર્ગીકરણ

Mechanical pulping મુખ્યત્વે mechanical energyથી fibres છૂટા પાડે છે:yield ઊંચી,પરંતુ lignin વધુ રહે અને અનેક gradesમાં long-term brightness/strength ઓછી હોય છે. Chemical pulping lignin dissolve કરે છે:soda,sulfite તથા sulfate(Kraft). Semichemicalમાં partial chemical treatment પછી mechanical separation છે. Recycled-fibre pulpingમાં used paper repulp કરીને screening/cleaning/deinking થઈ શકે છે. Yield,strength,brightness,cost તથા recovery મુજબ method પસંદ થાય છે.

Paperના Properties તથા Uses

Basis weight,moisture,formation,tensile/tear/burst strength,smoothness,opacity,porosity તથા absorbency પસંદગીને અસર કરે છે. Writing/printing,packaging,tissue તથા technical gradesમાં fibres/fillers/sizing જુદાં હોય છે. દરેક pulp bleach તથા દરેક paper coat થતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

The sulfate or Kraft process is alkaline chemical pulping with NaOH/Na2S white liquor,with recovery of chemicals and energy from black liquor.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Wood/bamboo chips,white liquor,water and recovery-cycle make-up.

Na2CO3 + Ca(OH)2 → 2NaOH + CaCO3;CaCO3 → CaO + CO2;CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2(recovery cycle). Cooking itself is a complex lignin-cleavage chemistry.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Chip preparation and digester construction

Chips are screened for size and impregnated with white liquor.The pressure-rated digester provides controlled heat/contact so alkaline/sulfide chemistry breaks lignin structures and frees cellulose-rich fibres.Uniform chips reduce uncooked centres and overcooked fragments.The name sulfate reflects the historical make-up/recovery chemistry;the cooking liquor is not simply a sodium-sulfate solution.

2. Blow,wash,screen and pulp finishing

Cooked stock is discharged to a blow tank,where pressure release separates fibres and recovers flash heat as designed.Brown-stock washing removes dissolved lignin and spent chemicals as weak black liquor.Screening/cleaning removes knots and contaminants.Bleaching is added only for the grade required;unbleached Kraft is suitable for many packaging products.Washing loss sends valuable chemicals to effluent instead of recovery.

3. Black-liquor concentration and recovery furnace

Evaporators concentrate black liquor so its organic content can provide fuel in the recovery boiler.Organic matter supplies heat/steam,and inorganic cooking chemicals emerge in smelt.The smelt is dissolved to green liquor containing carbonate/sulfide.Water contact with hot smelt is a major recovery-boiler safety issue,so these operations require dedicated engineered protection.

4. Causticising and lime loop

Causticising converts carbonate to NaOH using slaked lime;separation returns white liquor to the digester.Lime mud is washed and calcined in the lime kiln,then slaked for reuse.Sodium/sulfur and lime loops are related butnot identical:the lime kiln does not directly make the entire NaOH/Na2S cooking mixture.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control chip uniformity,cooking severity,washing,alkali/sulfide balance,recovery-boiler safety,odorous reduced-sulfur gases and effluent load.No matching Kraft sheet exists in the supplied set.

Properties / applications

Strong pulp for packaging,paperboard and,after appropriate bleaching/finishing,printing and other paper grades.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

NaOH/Na2S white liquorથી alkaline chemical pulping તથા black liquorમાંથી chemicals/energy recoveryની પદ્ધતિ sulfate/Kraft process છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Wood/bamboo chips,white liquor,water તથા recovery-cycle make-up લેવાય છે.

Na2CO3 + Ca(OH)2 → 2NaOH + CaCO3;CaCO3 → CaO + CO2;CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2(recovery cycle). Cooking itself is a complex lignin-cleavage chemistry.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Chip Preparation તથા Digester Construction

Chips size-screen થઈ white liquorથી impregnate થાય છે. Pressure-rated digesterમાં controlled heat/contactથી alkaline/sulfide chemistry lignin તોડી cellulose-rich fibres મુક્ત કરે છે. Uniform chipsથી uncooked centres/overcooked fragments ઘટે છે. Sulfate નામ historical make-up/recoveryથી છે;cooking liquor ફક્ત sodium-sulfate solution નથી.

2. Blow,Wash,Screen તથા Pulp Finishing

Cooked stock blow tankમાં discharge થાય છે;pressure releaseથી fibres છૂટા પડે છે અને design પ્રમાણે flash heat recover થાય છે. Brown-stock washing dissolved lignin તથા spent chemicalsને weak black liquor તરીકે કાઢે છે. Screening/cleaning knots/contaminants દૂર કરે છે. Gradeને જોઈએ ત્યારે જ bleaching થાય છે;unbleached Kraft અનેક packaging products માટે યોગ્ય છે. Washing lossથી chemicals recoveryને બદલે effluentમાં જાય છે.

3. Black-liquor Concentration તથા Recovery Furnace

Evaporators black liquor concentrate કરે છે,જેથી organic content recovery boilerમાં fuel આપે. Organic matterથી heat/steam મળે છે અને inorganic chemicals smeltમાં આવે છે. Smelt dissolve કરીને carbonate/sulfideવાળું green liquor બને છે. Hot smelt અને water contact મોટો safety issue છે;dedicated engineered protection જરૂરી છે.

4. Causticising તથા Lime Loop

Causticisingમાં slaked lime carbonateને NaOHમાં ફેરવે છે;separation પછી white liquor digesterમાં પાછું જાય છે. Lime mud wash/calcine થઈ lime kiln પછી slake થઈ reuse થાય છે. Sodium/sulfur તથા lime loops સંબંધિત પણ એકસરખાં નથી;lime kiln સીધું સમગ્ર NaOH/Na2S mixture બનાવતું નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Chip uniformity,cooking severity,washing,alkali/sulfide balance,recovery-boiler safety,odorous sulfur gases તથા effluent load નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Supplied setમાં matching Kraft sheet નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Strong pulp packaging,paperboard તથા યોગ્ય bleaching/finishing પછી printing/other paper gradesમાં વપરાય છે.

notes.reaction: Na2CO3 + Ca(OH)2 → 2NaOH + CaCO3;CaCO3 → CaO + CO2;CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2(recovery cycle). Cooking itself is a complex lignin-cleavage chemistry.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

A Fourdrinier machine continuously forms paper on a moving wire from dilute pulp stock,then presses and thermally dries the wet web.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Prepared pulp,process water and grade-specific sizing,filler,retention/strength additives.

Physical sheet formation/dewatering;not a new cellulose-polymerisation reaction.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Stock preparation and headbox

Pulp is dispersed,refined as required and mixed with suitable additives.Cleaners/screens remove material that can cause web defects.The approach-flow system supplies uniform dilute stock to the headbox.The headbox distributes a controlled jet across machine width;nonuniform flow causes basis-weight and formation variation.

2. Wire table,couch and press section

The moving wire supports fibre deposition while gravity,table elements and suction remove water.White water is collected and partly recycled with fibre recovery.The couch/suction stage strengthens the wet web for transfer.Press nips mechanically squeeze water into felts or the collection system;pressing saves later thermal duty and is not equivalent to evaporative drying.

3. Dryers,finishing and reel

The web passes over steam-heated cylinders and moisture is evaporated under controlled ventilation.Drying must be uniform to limit breaks,curl and dimensional variation.Sizing/coating/calendering are grade-dependent finishing operations;smooth calender rolls modify surface/compactness.The sheet is wound and cut to the required format.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control stock consistency,jet/wire conditions,retention,press moisture,dryer profile and final basis weight.Provide guards for nip points and steam systems;recover water without accumulating contaminants.

Properties / applications

Writing/printing,packaging,tissue and technical papers with grade-specific furnish and finishing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Dilute pulp stockમાંથી moving wire પર continuous sheet બનાવી pressing/thermal dryingથી paper બનાવતી machine Fourdrinier છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Prepared pulp,process water તથા grade-specific sizing,filler,retention/strength additives લેવાય છે.

Physical sheet formation/dewatering;not a new cellulose-polymerisation reaction.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Stock Preparation તથા Headbox

Pulp disperse/refine થઈ suitable additives સાથે mix થાય છે. Cleaners/screens web defects કરતું material દૂર કરે છે. Approach-flow system headboxને uniform dilute stock આપે છે. Headbox machine widthમાં controlled jet વહેંચે છે;nonuniform flowથી basis-weight/formation બદલાય છે.

2. Wire Table,Couch તથા Press Section

Moving wire fibre depositionને support કરે છે;gravity,table elements તથા suctionથી water નીકળે છે. White water collect થઈ fibre recovery સાથે partly recycle થાય છે. Couch/suctionથી web transfer માટે મજબૂત બને છે. Press nips mechanical રીતે felts/collectionમાં water કાઢે છે;આગળની thermal duty ઘટે છે અને તે evaporative drying સમાન નથી.

3. Dryers,Finishing તથા Reel

Web steam-heated cylinders પરથી પસાર થાય છે અને controlled ventilationથી moisture evaporate થાય છે. Uniform dryingથી breaks,curl તથા dimensional variation ઘટે છે. Sizing/coating/calendering grade-dependent છે;smooth calender rolls surface/compactness બદલે છે. Sheet wind/cut થઈ required format મળે છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Stock consistency,jet/wire conditions,retention,press moisture,dryer profile તથા final basis weight નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Nip points/steam systems guard કરવા તથા contaminants accumulate કર્યા વગર water recover કરવું.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Grade-specific furnish/finishingથી writing/printing,packaging,tissue તથા technical papersમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Formation,strength and machine operation

Variable fibre quality/refining/stock consistency causes uneven formation and weak sheets.Deposits,pitch,foam and dirt produce holes and breaks.Maintain screening,cleaning,wet-end chemistry and wire/felt condition.Speed changes must respect web strength,drainage and dryer capacity rather than increasing throughput blindly.

Water,energy and environmental load

Poor pressing increases steam duty;recover condensate/heat and optimise dewatering.High water reuse lowers intake but can build up salts,organics and microbes.Black-liquor loss,bleach effluent and wastewater need source control and treatment.Reduced-sulfur odour,dust and recovery-boiler emissions require appropriate systems;recovery does not mean zero waste.
body.gu:
Formation,Strength તથા Machine Operation

Variable fibre quality/refining/consistencyથી uneven formation તથા weak sheets મળે છે. Deposits,pitch,foam/dirtથી holes/breaks થાય છે. Screening,cleaning,wet-end chemistry તથા wire/felt જાળવવાં. Speed વધારતાં web strength,drainage તથા dryer capacity ધ્યાનમાં લેવાં.

Water,Energy તથા Environmental Load

Poor pressingથી steam duty વધે છે;condensate/heat recover કરીને dewatering સુધારવું. Water reuse intake ઘટાડે છે,પણ salts,organics/microbes accumulate થઈ શકે છે. Black-liquor loss,bleach effluent તથા wastewaterનું source control/treatment જરૂરી. Sulfur odour,dust તથા recovery-boiler emissions માટે systems જોઈએ;recoveryનો અર્થ zero waste નથી.

Given → Find → Formula → Substitution → Answer

1.Given:1000kg wet web at60%water;final sheet5%water,wet basis.No dry-solid loss.

2.Find:final sheet mass and water removed.

3.Dry solids=1000×0.40=400kg.

4.Final sheet=400/0.95=421.05kg;final water=21.05kg.

5.Water removed=600−21.05=578.95kg.

Aim

Study bamboo pulp preparation

Principle

Alkaline chemical pulping removes lignin to liberate bamboo fibres.

Apparatus/materials

Teacher-prepared bamboo chips/pulp,approved digester demonstration or process model,screen,wash/filter equipment.

Supervised procedure / record

Record chip preparation,cooking-liquor identity and the supervised cooking stage.Only trained staff operate a pressure digester.Observe washing/screening,collect the permitted pulp fraction and record dry yield and fibre appearance.Label model-based work as a study;do not invent a cooking result.

Dry chips(g):____;dry screened pulp(g):____;rejects(g):____;wash evidence:____

Calculations and result

Result:____;units:____;SOP/reference:____.No experiment/readings/results have been fabricated.

Precautions and waste

Protect against hot alkali,pressure and fibre dust;black liquor goes to approved treatment.
